weekend_race.race_comments: Denny Hamlin has won the FireKeepers Casino 400 at Michigan International Speedway, his 63rd victory in the NASCAR Cup Series annual exhibition event. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: Nos. 2, 11, 20, 21, 24, 43 (Unapproved Adjustments).
